observations: Photo 0 shows a white, cube-shaped device with a black Apple logo on the top surface.
Photo 1 shows the same device from a slightly different angle, revealing ports on the back: three Ethernet ports, one USB port, and a power connector.
Photo 2 is a close-up of the back panel, showing three Ethernet ports (two with up/down arrows, one with a USB symbol), a USB port, and a power connector with two circular pins.
The device appears to be an Apple AirPort Extreme or similar router, but no model number or text is visible on the device itself.
The seller claims it is an 'Apple Airport 6', but no such model exists; Apple's last AirPort Extreme was the 6th generation, released in 2013, often called 'AirPort Extreme 6'.
